items.title: 3.1 Cells: zindagi ki bunyadi ikai (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the chapter opening and topic 3.1, printed pages 48-49, in the book's order.

blocks.text: Is chapter "Cell and Subcellular Organelles" mein hum cells ko tafseel se parhenge. Cells woh bunyadi ikaiyan (fundamental units) hain jin se tamam jandar bane hain. Grade IX mein jo aap ne parha, us ke aage hum cell theory parhenge aur janwar aur poday dono ke cells ki banawat (structure) dekhenge. Aap cell signalling ke zaroori amal aur stem cells ki zabardast salahiyat (potential) ke bare mein bhi janenge. Is ke ilawa hum membrane transport ke tareeqe (mechanisms) dekhenge jo cell ke kaam ke liye bohat zaroori hain.

Cells zindagi ki basic unit (bunyadi ikai) hain; har jandar (organism) cells se bana hai. Unicellular (ek cell wale) jandaron, jaise amoeba aur bacteria, mein ek hi cell zindagi ke saare kaam karta hai. Multicellular (bohat se cells wale) jandar, jaise poday aur janwar, bohat se specialized (khaas kaam ke liye bane hue) cells se bante hain jo mil kar zindagi qaim rakhte hain.

Aap jante hain ke tamam jandar zindagi ki saat basic properties (khususiyat) dikhate hain: movement (harkat), respiration (saans/tawanai banana), homeostasis (andar ka mahol barabar rakhna), growth (barhna), reproduction (naslein barhana), excretion (fuzla nikalna) aur nutrition (ghiza lena). Yehi properties jandar ki pehchan hain. Cells hi woh saare bunyadi kaam karte hain jo jandar ki pehchan hain.

items: Movement: Cells harkat kar sakte hain. Misal ke taur par sperm cells apne flagella (dum jaisi lambi bal-numa banawat) se tairte hain. White blood cells infection se larne ke liye khoon mein safar karte hain. Cell ke andar organelles bhi zaroori kaam ke liye harkat karte hain.
Nutrition: Cells apne mahol (environment) se nutrients (ghizai ajza) lete hain taake energy banayen, cell ke hisse tayyar karen aur biochemical reactions chalayen.
Respiration: Cells respiration se energy banate hain. Is amal mein glucose toot kar ATP deta hai; ATP energy ki currency hai jo cell ke saare kaam chalati hai.
Excretion: Cells waste (fuzla) ko diffusion aur active transport se bahar nikalte hain, taake zehreele (toxic) mawad jama na hon.
Homeostasis: Cells apni membranes ke aar-paar mawad ki aamad-o-raft ko control kar ke andar ka mahol stable (ek jaisa) rakhte hain.
Growth: Cells nutrients le kar unhen cell ke hisson (components) mein badalte hain aur is tarah barhte hain.

Reproduction: Cells mitosis aur meiosis se taqseem (divide) ho kar barhte hain. Mitosis growth aur repair (marammat) ke liye bilkul ek jaise daughter cells banata hai, jabke meiosis sexual reproduction ke liye gametes (jinsi cells) banata hai.

blocks.prompt: Ek akela bacterium aur ek insaan dono zinda hain. Saat properties mein se kaun si properties akela bacterial cell khud anjam deta hai?
blocks.explanation: Saaton. Unicellular jandar mein ek hi cell sab kuch karta hai: harkat karta hai, nutrients leta hai, respiration karta hai, waste nikalta hai, andar ka mahol stable rakhta hai, barhta hai aur reproduce karta hai. Multicellular jandar mein specialized cells yeh kaam aapas mein baant lete hain.

items: Cells zindagi ki basic unit hain; unicellular jandar ek cell hai, multicellular jandar bohat se specialized cells se bana hai jo mil kar kaam karte hain.
Zindagi ki saat properties (movement, respiration, homeostasis, growth, reproduction, excretion, nutrition) sab cells anjam dete hain.
Respiration glucose se ATP banata hai; mitosis growth aur repair ke liye ek jaise cells deta hai; meiosis gametes deta hai.
